result.title: The Stability Gap in Continual Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) aims to enable agents to adapt to changing tasks while preserving previously acquired capabilities. Evaluation often relies on final aggregate metrics that can hide temporary performance degradation during adaptation. This work introduces a simple CRL benchmark that varies observation representations while preserving environment dynamics and rewards, supporting proof-of-concept demonstrations, inexpensive experimentation, and easily reproducible sanity checks. Using this benchmark, we demonstrate the stability gap in CRL: a substantial drop in prior-task performance after the introduction of new tasks, followed by partial or complete recovery. This pattern occurs despite the agent having complete access to past tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一个保持环境动力学与奖励不变、仅改变观察表示的持续强化学习基准，并据此展示「稳定性差距」：引入新任务后旧任务性能显著下降、随后部分或完全恢复，即使智能体可访问全部过去任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只换观察表示、不换动力学」的基准设计可能可供核查视觉表征变化如何影响 latent 推理状态的保持与恢复；聚合指标掩盖适应期性能回退的现象，也与推理过程中间状态和停止决策的评价方式有间接类比。
